title: wtctl baseline check --json
description: The unchanged case (exit 0). A change exits 20 with error.json: reason repo_config_changed, items, details {digest, recorded_digest, changed_classes}.

format.description: Present only for a record whose baseline was recorded before symlink targets were covered (format 1); it is compared by the format 1 collector. baseline accept re-records it as format 2.

new_coverage.description: Only with format, and only when not empty: the items a baseline accept would add (symlink targets); one with a detail would block it. A notice, never a failure.
